comment: The public roadmap. `bun nv site --check roadmap` keeps it in step with the goal chain, and `bun nv site --roadmap` copies it into README.md. `internal` lists the goals that are not public work.

themes.title: Spreadsheets and PDF
themes.text: `Novis\Spreadsheet` computes formulas, writes `.ods` files and reads every part of every format it opens. The spreadsheet and PDF extensions check more of their input, and PDF tables lay out like a browser draws them.

themes.title: Request limits inside every call
themes.text: Every `Core` method is tested against a small memory limit, and each method that goes past it is fixed. A long call inside the runtime also stops at the request's time, CPU and stack limits.
